function prepare({payload,dataSourceId,personId}){if(typeof dataSourceId!=='string'||!dataSourceId.trim()||dataSourceId.startsWith('YOUR_')||typeof personId!=='string'||!personId.trim()||personId.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure the Notion data source and person');if(!payload||typeof payload.email!=='string'||!payload.email.trim()||typeof payload.name!=='string'||!payload.name.trim())throw Error('Booking is missing the invitee name or email');const e=payload.scheduled_event,start=e?.start_time,end=e?.end_time;if(typeof start!=='string'||typeof end!=='string'||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(start))||!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(end))||Date.parse(end)<=Date.parse(start))throw Error('Booking has invalid scheduled event times');const contact={email:payload.email,full_name:payload.name};for(const k of['first_name','last_name'])if(typeof payload[k]==='string'&&payload[k].trim())contact[k]=payload[k];return{data:[contact],booking:{start,end},dataSourceId,personId}}

return $input.all().flatMap((x,i)=>{if(x.json.event!=='invitee.created')return [];const p=prepare({payload:x.json.payload,dataSourceId:'YOUR_NOTION_DATA_SOURCE_ID',personId:'YOUR_NOTION_PERSON_ID'});return [{json:{...p.data[0],booking:p.booking,dataSourceId:p.dataSourceId,personId:p.personId},pairedItem:{item:i}}]});

function page({data,error,success,status,booking,dataSourceId,personId}){if(error!==false||success!==true||status!=='succeeded'||!Array.isArray(data)||data.length!==1)throw Error('Dropcontact enrichment is not complete; inspect the request before retrying');if(typeof dataSourceId!=='string'||!dataSourceId.trim()||dataSourceId.startsWith('YOUR_')||typeof personId!=='string'||!personId.trim()||personId.startsWith('YOUR_'))throw Error('Configure the Notion data source and person');const r=data[0],email=r?.email?.[0]?.email;if(typeof r?.full_name!=='string'||!r.full_name.trim()||typeof email!=='string'||!email.trim())throw Error('Enriched contact is missing full name or first email');const properties={Date:{date:{start:booking.start,end:booking.end}},email:{email},Leads:{title:[{text:{content:r.full_name}}]},Person:{people:[{id:personId}]}};for(const [source,target]of[['linkedin','LinkedIn Profile'],['website','Website'],['company_linkedin','LinkedIn Company']]){const v=r[source];if(v===undefined||v===null||v==='')continue;if(typeof v!=='string')throw Error('Invalid enriched URL');properties[target]={url:v}}if(r.civility!==undefined&&r.civility!==null&&r.civility!==''){if(typeof r.civility!=='string')throw Error('Invalid civility');properties.Civility={rich_text:[{text:{content:r.civility}}]}}return{parent:{data_source_id:dataSourceId},properties}}

const p=$('Prepare booking and contact').first().json;return [{json:page({data:$input.all().map(x=>x.json),error:false,success:true,status:'succeeded',booking:p.booking,dataSourceId:p.dataSourceId,personId:p.personId})}];
